headline: Mugur Isărescu: Disinflation Is Taking Shape, but the Return to Balance Will Be Gradual
summary: BNR Governor Mugur Isărescu said disinflation is taking shape in the Inflation Report of 16 November. He warned that inflationary pressures from fiscal and energy shocks have not disappeared.
why: The National Bank of Romania sets monetary policy for the leu, and its inflation outlook guides interest rate expectations for Romanian bonds and currency.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Mugur Isărescu: Dezinflația prinde contur, dar revenirea la echilibru va fi graduală
